svg.title: Active Directory Attack Chain Flowchart
svg.desc: Sequential flowchart showing the 9-stage AD attack chain from reconnaissance to Golden Ticket persistence, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK techniques.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the Reconnaissance stage in the AD attack chain')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about Kerberos User Enumeration in the AD attack chain')
sendPrompt('Explain the AS-REP Roasting technique in detail')
sendPrompt('How does offline password cracking work against Kerberos hashes?')
sendPrompt('What does (Pwn3d!) mean in CrackMapExec output?')
sendPrompt('Explain the three RCE methods used in the AD attack chain')
sendPrompt('How does PSExec achieve SYSTEM level?')
sendPrompt('Why is WMIExec stealthier than PSExec?')
sendPrompt('What is RID cycling and why is it useful for domain enumeration?')
sendPrompt('How does DCSync extract credentials from Active Directory?')
sendPrompt('How does a Golden Ticket provide persistent Active Directory access?')
